description:
Wait until the message arrives and has been analysed, then summarise it.

    Call it after the email has been sent to the address from
    get_test_address. Blocks rather than returning "not ready yet": an agent
    told to poll writes a sleep loop and usually gives up before the analysis
    finishes. Provider placement keeps filling in for up to 30 minutes after
    the report; get_report reads the latest.

slug.description: The slug get_test_address returned, the last part of the report URL.
slug.title: Slug

timeout_seconds.description: How long to block waiting for the message and its analysis, in seconds. The checks are ready in well under a minute; the fix plan takes about another one. Past this the tool returns what it has.
timeout_seconds.title: Timeout Seconds
